name: sage
description: Search, read and file Markdown notes, Obsidian vaults and Sage drives, the card index your agent keeps, with the sage CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Your Markdown notes as a card index Codex keeps
interface.longDescription: Use the sage CLI from Codex on a folder of Markdown, an Obsidian vault or a Sage drive, kept as a card index: kinds of cards with their forms, tabs, house rules and standing lists. Full-text search, the [[wikilink]] graph, frontmatter records, a drive's named queries and its check, as JSON.
defaultPrompt: Use sage to find the notes in this folder about a topic and the notes they link to
Use sage to file these meeting notes as cards in this drive
Use sage to check this drive and fix the records it reports
